name: Beta 4
summary: Manifest-based release information and a refreshed About page.
changes: Release metadata and history come from each version's local manifest.
About shows the active version, compatibility, release highlights and historical notes.
Settings branding uses RusticQ consistently; release packages use the active manifest.
Time → Advanced opens a shared countdown timer with custom duration, presets, pause, resume, reset and completion notifications.
Calendar dates support local notes, categories, colored markers and a compact Add/Edit action.
Decorative divider lines are replaced by spacing while important borders remain; device settings use a compact floating window.
Active RusticQ recordings show a customizable blinking red dot with corner, size and inset controls in Modules settings.
